summary: Master Selenium, Appium, and CI/CD in our 5-day Test Automation and Quality Engineering course. Build scalable frameworks and accelerate your SDET career today.
lede: Test automation and quality engineering apply automated tools and engineering practices across the software testing lifecycle. For QA engineers, developers, SDETs and DevOps professionals, the course addresses designing repeatable tests and integrating them into delivery workflows. It covers Selenium framework design with the Page Object Model, API validation using REST Assured, and continuous testing with Jenkins, alongside BDD, mobile and performance testing.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for technical professionals responsible for ensuring software reliability and performance in automated environments.
audience: Mobile Test Specialists using Appium for cross-platform
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of software testing concepts and at least 6 months of experience in a QA role. Familiarity with basic programming logic (Java, Python, or C#) is required, as the course involves hands-on coding. No prior experience with Selenium or Appium is necessary, but a laptop with administrative rights for software installation is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
